items: Never have I ever eaten food off the floor.
Never have I ever fallen asleep in class or at work.
Never have I ever pretended to be on a call to avoid someone.
Never have I ever sent a message to the wrong person.
Never have I ever laughed so hard I cried at a bad moment.
Never have I ever eaten an entire pizza alone.
Never have I ever got lost in a familiar place.
Never have I ever blamed the network for not replying.
Never have I ever talked to myself in the mirror.
Never have I ever forgotten someone's name right after meeting.
Never have I ever stalked an old photo and liked it by accident.
Never have I ever lied about being sick to skip something.
Never have I ever sung in the shower with full drama.
Never have I ever missed a flight, train or bus.
Never have I ever worn clothes inside out all day.
Never have I ever binge-watched a whole series in one night.
Never have I ever pretended to like a gift.
Never have I ever laughed at my own joke before the punchline.
